edges.reason: msg.sender is hashed into the merkle node, used as the users mapping key and as the mint recipient in the presale path.
msg.sender is used as the users mapping key and as the mint recipient in the public sale path.
withdraw is restricted to the owner (msg.sender) and pays the entire balance back to msg.sender.
msg.sender is part of the keccak256 seed used to derive the pseudo-random token id.
block.timestamp is included in the randomness seed, making token ids timestamp dependent.
block.timestamp feeds the weak randomness computation.
_randMod produces a predictable pseudo-random value from nonce, msg.sender, block.difficulty and block.timestamp.
withdraw forwards the whole contract balance through a low-level send.
_checkOnERC721Received performs an external call into the recipient contract, allowing it to re-enter during mint/transfer.
mintGiveawayNFT calls _randMod inside its mint loop to obtain a token id.
mintPreSaleNFT calls _randMod inside its mint loop to obtain a token id.
mintSaleNFT calls _randMod inside its mint loop to obtain a token id.
The value returned by _randMod is passed as tokenId to _safeMint.
mintGiveawayNFT mints through _safeMint.
mintPreSaleNFT mints through _safeMint to msg.sender.
mintSaleNFT mints through _safeMint to msg.sender.
_safeMint performs the actual state mutation via _mint before the receiver check.
_safeMint invokes _checkOnERC721Received after minting.
_mint shares balance/owner bookkeeping semantics with _transfer.
max supply cap MAX_NFT bounds the giveaway mint loop.
MAX_NFT is compared against totalSupply + _count in the presale mint.
MAX_NFT is compared against totalSupply + _count in the sale mint.
_randMod uses MAX_NFT to compute totalSize for the index bound.
MAX_MINT_PRESALE bounds users[msg.sender].presalemint + _count.
MAX_MINT_SALE bounds users[msg.sender].salemint + _count.
MAX_BY_MINT_IN_TRANSACTION_PRESALE bounds _count per presale transaction.
MAX_BY_MINT_IN_TRANSACTION_SALE bounds _count per sale transaction.
PRESALE_MINTED is incremented once per presale token minted.
SALE_MINTED is incremented once per sale token minted.
GIVEAWAY_MINTED is incremented once per giveaway token minted.
PRESALE_PRICE * _count is compared against msg.value.
SALE_PRICE * _count is compared against msg.value.
presaleEnable gates the presale mint function.
saleEnable gates the public sale mint function.
baseURI is concatenated with the token id inside tokenURI.
merkleRoot is the root used by MerkleProof.verify for the caller leaf.
indices array stores and resolves the swap-and-pop index mapping in _randMod.
nonce seeds the randomness and is incremented on every _randMod call.
users[msg.sender].presalemint is read and written for presale accounting.
users[msg.sender].salemint is read and written for sale accounting.
setURI writes the new URI into baseURI.
updateSalePrice (owner only) writes SALE_PRICE.
updatePreSalePrice (owner only) writes PRESALE_PRICE.
setSaleStatus (owner only) toggles saleEnable.
setPreSaleStatus (owner only) toggles presaleEnable.
updateSaleMintLimit (owner only) writes MAX_MINT_SALE.
updatePreSaleMintLimit (owner only) writes MAX_MINT_PRESALE.
updateMintLimitPerTransectionPreSale (owner only) writes MAX_BY_MINT_IN_TRANSACTION_PRESALE.
updateMintLimitPerTransectionSale (owner only) writes MAX_BY_MINT_IN_TRANSACTION_SALE.
updateMerkleRoot (owner only) writes merkleRoot.
setSaleStatus reads saleEnable to require a status change.
setPreSaleStatus reads presaleEnable to require a status change.
_to is the recipient passed to _safeMint in mintGiveawayNFT.
_count drives the loop that repeatedly calls _randMod and _safeMint.
_count drives the presale mint loop and the pricing/limit checks.
merkleProof is forwarded to MerkleProof.verify.
The hashed leaf node of msg.sender is compared against merkleRoot.
_count drives the sale mint loop and the pricing/limit checks.
_URI is assigned to baseURI by setURI.
newPrice is assigned to SALE_PRICE by updateSalePrice.
newLimit is validated against MAX_NFT and assigned to MAX_MINT_SALE.
totalSize bounds the modulo used to compute the random index.
index selects the swap-and-pop slot in the indices array.
value is the computed token id returned by _randMod.

normalization_plan.reason: The recipient parameter _to only exists to serve mintGiveawayNFT's _safeMint call and should be folded into that core function node.
The loop counter parameter _count only controls mintGiveawayNFT's minting loop.
_count is the presale quantity parameter consumed exclusively by mintPreSaleNFT's checks and loop.
merkleProof is only consumed by the MerkleProof.verify call inside mintPreSaleNFT.
The local leaf hash node is derived from msg.sender solely for the presale whitelist check.
_count is the sale quantity parameter consumed exclusively by mintSaleNFT's checks and loop.
_URI is written to baseURI only inside setURI.
newPrice is written to SALE_PRICE only inside updateSalePrice.
newLimit is validated and written to MAX_MINT_SALE only inside updateSaleMintLimit.
totalSize is a transient computation local to _randMod's randomness logic.
index is a transient computation local to _randMod's randomness logic.
value is the transient token id produced by _randMod before being returned.
